remarks: Beautifully maintained three-bedroom split-level home offering refined yet comfortable living. Highlights include an elegant living room with fireplace, a spectacular sunroom wrapped in three walls of windows, a private den, and a fully finished lower level. Exceptional flexibility for both everyday living and entertaining, enhanced by a stunning custom-built terrace overlooking a serene, tree-lined property. Ideally situated near New Canaan and Wilton, just minutes to top schools, shopping, dining, the New Canaan train station, and The Lake Club.
